subject: Transportation Systems
title: Electronic Charts
description: A quick win: understand Electronic Charts.

hook.text: Paper nautical charts were the backbone of navigation for 500 years. Now they're going digital.

buildup.text: Electronic Chart Display Systems overlay the ship's GPS position on detailed digital maps in real time.

discovery.text: The system warns if the ship's course heads toward shallow water, rocks, or restricted zones.

twist.text: Digital charts must be updated weekly. Out-of-date charts have caused real groundings.

climax.text: Regulators now accept electronic charts as the primary navigation tool—paper is optional on most ships.

punchline.text: The ancient art of charting went from parchment to pixels.

quiz.question: What advantage do electronic charts offer over paper charts?
options: Real-time position overlay and safety warnings
